title: Whitefly DNA Extraction and mtCO1 Gene Amplification
author: Joachim Nwezeobi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdvri656
materials: The GeneJETPCR purification kit (Thermo Scientific)was used to purify amplicons of interest as described by the kit manufacturer.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer single whitefly adults from 70% ethanol storage to clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Randomly choose single whitefly adults from 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes containing 70% ethanol using a sterilized entomological pin.
Transfer each whitefly to a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract insect DNA using Chelex and heat incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl of 10% Chelex to the tube.
Crush the whitefly using a plastic pestle until a clear homogenised mixture is obtained.
Incubate the mixture at 56°C for 20 minutes.
Incubate the mixture at 100°C for five minutes.

steps.title: Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture to isolate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,500 g for five minutes using an Eppendorf Centrifuge 5424 R.
Collect the supernatant and store at -20°C until use.

steps.title: PCR Amplification of mtCO1 Gene
steps.instruction: Amplify mtCO1 fragments using a thermal cycler with specific primer sets.

substeps.instruction: Select one of two primer sets: (i) African specific 2195Bt (5’-TGRTTTTTTGGTCATCCRGAAGT-3’) and C012/Bt-sh2 (5’-TTTACTGCACTTTCTGCC-3’) or (ii) generic CI-J-2195 (5’-TTGATTTTTTGGTCATCCAGAAGT-3’) and TL2-N-3014 (TCCAATGCACTAATCTGCCATATTA-3’).

Run PCR on an Applied Biosystems 2720 thermal cycler for 35 cycles using the following conditions: initial denaturation at 94°C for 2 minutes; denaturation at 94°C for 20 seconds; annealing at 52°C for 30 seconds; extension at 72°C for one minute; and final extension at 72°C for five minutes.

steps.title: Confirm PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Verify the amplification of the PCR products using agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Perform electrophoresis using 1% w/v agarose gel in 0.5 X Tris/borate/EDTA buffer.
